messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing service->service handshake failures (checkout-api -> pricing) in eu-west and ap-south after the RBAC change this morning. Proxy logs show KMS unwrap AccessDenied.
ajay: Which RBAC change was deployed? link to PR? @maria
maria: PR #234 (keystore-access-tighten). Minimal change but looks like it removed a binding for svc-keystore in some regions. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-21T09:12:34Z proxy[checkout-api] ERROR keystore: unwrap failed key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck/cryptoKeyVersions/1 error=AccessDenied
caused_by: com.cloud.kms.AccessDeniedException: caller does not have permission to access key
```
lucas: Confirmed similar stack traces on ap-south canary earlier. Suspect IAM sync script pruned region-specific binding when scope tightened.
dina: I rolled back a staging binding yesterday but didn't touch prod. @sre-ops can you pull IAM audit logs for the last 6h?
sre-ops: Pulling now. Also creating an incident so we have an audit trail — INC-2026-042 created.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by sre-ops — priority: P1 — services impacted: checkout-api, pricing, pricing-worker
ajay: We also see missing keystore unwrap audit entries in eu-west during the time window. Could be an audit-filter change on the proxy or a logging rollout.
maria: Checking deploy manifests: keystore-proxy flags — looks like a canary accidentally flipped `--audit-filter=none` in eu-west template. Oof.
lucas: Two-pronged mitigation: 1) Re-add IAM binding for kms.unwrap to svc-keystore in eu-west/ap-south 2) Patch proxy flag to re-enable unwrap audit logs and restart.
dina: I can apply the temporary IAM binding (emergency) but need approval from security leads. @maria please ack. :+1:
maria: Ack — approve emergency binding for svc-keystore (limited to unwrap permission and specific key versions). After binding, we'll monitor unwrap success and audit presence.
sre-ops: Applied binding in eu-west and ap-south, restarted keystore-proxy pods. Early telemetry: unwrap returns 200, handshake errors drop to 0.
rotator-bot: keystore-rotator paused automatically at 09:10 due to unwrap failures; it will resume once >95% unwrap success observed for 5m.
ajay: After change, audit entries are present again for keystore:unwrap requests. Need a follow-up to prevent regressions.
maria: Short term done. Postmortem items: - RBAC deploys must run a cross-region keystore unwrap canary - CI gating to prevent --audit-filter=none in prod manifests - Alert: KMS unwrap AccessDenied rate > 1/min per region - Document rollback playbook for keystore bindings
ajay: I'll file the follow-ups and tag sec-eng + infra for RBAC gating.
dina: I'll draft the incident note and coordinate the postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast response.
sec-bot: Postmortem draft created: PM-2026-042-keystore-unwrap-rbac-misconfig (link in #incidents)
